resources.name: GitHub Pages
resources.description: Publish a static site from a repository with a provider-hosted subdomain.

free_details.limits: Free access depends on repository visibility and plan. Usage and acceptable-use limits apply; a custom registered domain is a separate purchase.
free_details.cost_notes: Check hardware, hosting, optional services and third-party asset rights separately.

editorial.example: Publish a small documentation site from a public repository. Check its entry file, relative asset links and custom 404 page.
editorial.review_type: Official documentation reviewed
editorial.tradeoff: Free access depends on repository visibility and plan. Usage and acceptable-use limits apply; a custom registered domain is a separate purchase.
editorial.details: Publish a small documentation site from a public repository. Check its entry file, relative asset links and custom 404 page. Keep an editable source or reproducible configuration and check the output before committing to the workflow. The example is a suggested exercise, not a claim of hands-on testing.

resources.name: Cloudflare Pages
resources.description: Build and deliver frontend sites with static hosting and optional server functions.

free_details.limits: Free-plan build, file and runtime limits apply. Functions and other Cloudflare services have separate quotas. A hosted subdomain is not a free registered domain.
free_details.cost_notes: Check hardware, hosting, optional services and third-party asset rights separately.

editorial.example: Deploy a small static preview and inspect its asset paths and cache headers before considering a custom domain.
editorial.review_type: Official documentation reviewed
editorial.tradeoff: Free-plan build, file and runtime limits apply. Functions and other Cloudflare services have separate quotas. A hosted subdomain is not a free registered domain.
